question: A2, predicted before the read of CAP-A2SAMEZ (Blocks Probe): does a pair that overlaps with the same z ever swap in the DOM on the oracle? Ours never swaps one: blocks with the same z paint in DOM order, so a swap would flip which one shows. Setup, two runs from a new blank section: a Shape (A, 1/2/7/8, z 1), a Button (B, z 2) moved 118 right and 205 down (6/4/8/10, over A's lower part), a Line (L, z 3) moved 452 down (12/2/13/6). Cmd+D on A gives A' one row down and one column right (2/3/8/9) at A's z + 1, so z 2, B's z, overlapping B, and last on the phone. Then L nudged right, then back left: each desktop move sets the phone order again, and phone rows put A' (row 2) before B (row 6).
rule: Ours as built (no swap): the held pair keeps its DOM order, B before A', and A' paints over B where they overlap. Rival F (follow): the phone rows win, A' before B, so B paints over A'.
